assertion_review.fails_if: The emitted PostToolUse array is empty or has additional groups.
The emitted group drops or changes the canonical inbox command; comparison to worker_inbox_group tests reuse of the existing owner, not correctness of that pre-existing owner.
Production ignores or changes the independently supplied probe key/hash or trusts additional entries; fixture values are literal expectations, not values read back from emitted argv.
The recorded dotted override implementation is reinstated instead of the inline hooks.state table.
Production adds the forbidden hook-trust bypass flag.
Composition writes, removes or modifies a file in the sentinel directory; actual operator-config preservation is additionally evidenced by the live gate before/after digests.
Discovery uses a request other than hooks/list.
The hook override moves after the resume subcommand.
Another registered dialect probes or emits the Codex hook/trust flags.
Missing, error or empty metadata is accepted rather than refused with BackendError.
Any parameterized unrelated source/event/handler/command, missing key or invalid hash is accepted.
Preview composition probes or creates a file for the absent run.
The direct exec exits unsuccessfully.
The stream lacks three completed commands or any completed command exits nonzero.
Composition or exec writes config.toml into the fresh scratch home.
The hook fails to claim the trusted message, as observed in the recorded trust-drop control.
Trusted delivery leaves the original message pending.
The receipt is missing, duplicated or names another message; message.name is independent filesystem input, not an echo returned by the code under test.
The trusted receipt reports failed delivery.
The final answer omits the independently generated inbox-only codeword, including when trust is dropped.
The untrusted run loses the pending message, claims it, writes any receipt or quotes the inbox-only codeword.

production_additions._CodexDialect._inbox_hook_flags: Extends dialect-owned argv composition; reuses worker_inbox_group, budget_probe handshake and run_probe transport.

test_additions._argv: Test-only wrapper around the existing dialect argv owner.
test_additions._overrides: Test-only TOML decoding through standard-library tomllib.
test_additions.hook_probe/answer: Scoped fixture transport stub; uses pytest monkeypatch, no production capability fork.
test_additions.test functions and nested answer: Assertions and fixture mutation, not production capability implementations.
